exercises.title: Bài 1 · Chọn từ đúng
exercises.instruction: Choose the best word to complete each sentence.
exercises.instruction_vi: Chọn thuật ngữ nhân sự phù hợp nhất.

content.q: The ___ lists the duties, responsibilities and required skills of a position.
content.why: **job description** = bản mô tả công việc.

content.q: HR reports that the company's ___ is 250, so it has 250 people on the payroll.
content.why: **headcount** = số lượng nhân sự.

content.q: A ___ works for several clients and is not an employee of any single company.
content.why: **freelancer** = người làm việc tự do.

content.q: High ___ means that many employees leave the company each year.
content.why: **turnover** = tỷ lệ nghỉ việc/luân chuyển nhân sự.

content.q: Her university degree is an important ___ for this job.
content.why: **qualification** = bằng cấp, trình độ.

content.q: A ___ contract has no end date.
content.why: **permanent** = chính thức, không giới hạn thời gian.

content.q: Staff are more motivated when the ___ is positive and people respect each other.
content.tip: culture = lối sống, giá trị chung.
content.why: **organisational culture** = văn hóa tổ chức.

content.q: The ___ of an employee is the amount of work he or she completes in a given time.
content.why: **productivity** = năng suất lao động.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Hiện tại đơn và hiện tại tiếp diễn
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.
exercises.instruction_vi: Ngữ pháp: thói quen/sự thật dùng hiện tại đơn; việc đang xảy ra dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn.

content.q: The HR department ___ every new employee's records.
content.why: Công việc thường xuyên → **hiện tại đơn**: keeps.

content.q: At the moment, we ___ for a new marketing manager.
content.why: 'At the moment' → **are looking**.

content.q: Our staff ___ from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday.
content.tip: lịch cố định → hiện tại đơn.
content.why: Lịch làm việc cố định; chủ ngữ số nhiều → **work**.

content.q: This week, the manager ___ interviews, so she is not in the office.
content.why: 'This week' = việc đang diễn ra → **is conducting**.

content.q: A good manager always ___ to her team.
content.why: 'always' + ngôi thứ ba số ít → **listens**.

content.q: The company ___ its workforce quickly this year.
content.tip: this year → xu hướng đang diễn ra.
content.why: 'this year' = thay đổi đang xảy ra → **is growing**.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Điền dạng đúng
exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.instruction_vi: Gõ dạng đúng của động từ (hiện tại đơn hoặc tiếp diễn).

content.q: She ___ (work) as an HR officer in a bank.
content.why: Nghề nghiệp → hiện tại đơn: **works**.

content.q: We ___ (not / hire) new staff at the moment.
content.why: 'at the moment' → **are not hiring**.

content.q: Turnover usually ___ (fall) when employees feel valued.
content.why: 'usually' → hiện tại đơn: **falls**.

content.q: Right now, the supervisor ___ (explain) the new rules to the team.
content.why: 'Right now' → **is explaining**.

content.q: Most employees ___ (prefer) flexible working hours.
content.why: Sự thật chung, chủ ngữ số nhiều → **prefer**.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · What does an HR department do?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Many people think that human resources only hires and fires staff, but the HR department does much more. It manages the whole relationship between the employer and its employees. Every company needs a clear job description for each role, so that employees know their responsibilities.

HR also looks after workforce planning. Managers tell HR their headcount needs, and HR checks the budget and the workload of each team. A company may employ full-time, part-time and temporary workers, and sometimes it works with freelancers on special projects.

Today, HR is also responsible for organisational culture and employee wellbeing. A friendly workplace improves productivity and lowers turnover, which saves money, because hiring and training a new person is expensive. That is why many companies see their employees as human capital: an investment, not only a cost.

content.q: HR only hires and fires staff.
content.why: Đoạn 1: HR làm **nhiều việc hơn** là tuyển và sa thải.

content.q: A job description helps employees know their responsibilities.
content.why: Đoạn 1: mỗi vai trò cần một job description rõ ràng.

content.q: A company never works with freelancers.
content.why: Đoạn 2: đôi khi công ty làm việc với **freelancers**.

content.q: A friendly workplace can lower turnover.
content.why: Đoạn 3: môi trường thân thiện cải thiện năng suất và giảm turnover.

content.q: What does HR check when managers ask for more people?
content.why: Đoạn 2: HR kiểm tra ngân sách và khối lượng công việc của từng nhóm.
opts: The budget and the workload of each team

content.q: Why is high turnover expensive?
content.why: Đoạn 3: tuyển và đào tạo người mới tốn kém.
opts: Hiring and training a new person costs a lot

content.q: What is HR also responsible for today?
content.why: Đoạn 3: HR cũng chịu trách nhiệm về văn hóa tổ chức và wellbeing.

content.q: Why do many companies call employees human capital?
content.why: Đoạn 3: nhân viên là một **khoản đầu tư**, không chỉ là chi phí.
opts: They see them as an investment

exercises.title: Bài 1 · So sánh hơn và so sánh nhất
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.
exercises.instruction_vi: Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn (-er / more) và so sánh nhất (-est / most).

content.q: Internal candidates are often ___ to hire than external ones.
content.why: So sánh hơn với 'than' → **easier**.

content.q: Online applications are ___ than paper forms.
content.why: Tính từ ngắn: **faster than**.

content.q: This is the ___ vacancy we have ever advertised; we received 800 applications.
content.why: So sánh nhất với tính từ dài → **the most popular**.

content.q: A panel interview is usually ___ stressful than a one-to-one interview.
content.why: 'stressful' dài → **more stressful**.

content.q: She is the ___ qualified of all the candidates.
content.why: So sánh nhất: **the most qualified**.

content.q: Hiring through referral is not as ___ as using an agency.
content.why: Cấu trúc **not as … as** → expensive.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Điền dạng đúng
exercises.instruction: Write the correct comparative or superlative form.
exercises.instruction_vi: Gõ dạng so sánh đúng của tính từ trong ngoặc.

content.q: Recruitment agencies are ___ (expensive) than job websites.
content.why: Tính từ dài: **more expensive than**.

content.q: He is the ___ (good) candidate we have interviewed this year.
content.why: 'good' bất quy tắc, so sánh nhất: **best**.

content.q: The second interview was ___ (difficult) than the first.
content.why: **more difficult than**.

content.q: Our selection process is ___ (short) than our competitors'.
content.why: Tính từ ngắn: **shorter than**.

content.q: This is the ___ (competitive) job market in ten years.
content.why: 'the … in ten years' → **most competitive**.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Hiring the right person
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
When a department has a vacancy, HR starts the recruitment process. First, HR writes a job advertisement with clear selection criteria and publishes it on job websites. Some companies also use a recruitment agency or a headhunter, but this is more expensive than advertising directly. A referral from a current employee is often the cheapest and quickest way to find a good person.

After the closing date, HR screens the CVs and cover letters and makes a shortlist. The shortlisted candidates take an aptitude test and attend an interview, sometimes with a panel. To avoid bias, interviewers ask every candidate the same questions and score the answers.

The final candidate receives a job offer, subject to references and a background check. Then the two sides negotiate the salary and the start date. Most new employees begin with a probation period of two or three months. A diverse team brings different ideas, so many employers now make diversity one of their most important recruitment goals.

content.q: HR writes the job advertisement and publishes it on job websites.
content.why: Đoạn 1: HR viết tin tuyển dụng và đăng lên các website.

content.q: A recruitment agency is cheaper than advertising directly.
content.why: Đoạn 1: dùng agency hoặc headhunter **đắt hơn** đăng tin trực tiếp.

content.q: Interviewers ask every candidate different questions to avoid bias.
content.why: Đoạn 2: để tránh bias, họ hỏi **cùng một bộ câu hỏi**.

content.q: Most new employees start with a probation period.
content.why: Đoạn 3: đa số nhân viên mới bắt đầu bằng thời gian thử việc.

content.q: What does HR do after the closing date?
content.why: Đoạn 2: HR sàng lọc CV, thư xin việc và lập shortlist.
opts: It screens the CVs and makes a shortlist

content.q: Why do interviewers ask the same questions?
content.why: Đoạn 2: hỏi giống nhau và chấm điểm để tránh thiên kiến.

content.q: What do the two sides negotiate after the job offer?
content.why: Đoạn 3: hai bên thương lượng lương và ngày bắt đầu.
opts: The salary and the start date

content.q: Why do many employers value diverse teams?
content.why: Đoạn 3: đội ngũ đa dạng mang lại nhiều ý tưởng khác nhau.

content.q: New employees attend an ___ on their first day to learn about the company's rules and culture.
content.why: **induction** = buổi định hướng cho nhân viên mới.

content.q: A senior manager acts as a ___ and gives advice to a younger colleague.
content.why: **mentor** = người hướng dẫn; người được hướng dẫn là **mentee**.

content.q: With ___, employees learn by doing real tasks at their own workplace.

content.why: **on-the-job training** = đào tạo tại nơi làm việc.

content.q: ___ teaches people new skills so they can move into a completely different job.

content.why: **reskilling** = đào tạo lại; **upskilling** = nâng cao kỹ năng hiện có.

content.q: A ___ shows the steps an employee may take from junior to senior positions.
content.why: **career path** = lộ trình sự nghiệp.

content.q: HR uses ___ to prepare people to replace senior managers when they retire.
content.why: **succession planning** = hoạch định người kế nhiệm.

content.q: After the course, HR carried out an ___ to see whether the training worked.
content.why: **evaluation** = sự đánh giá hiệu quả.

content.q: All new employees ___ an induction pack on their first day.

content.q: The training course ___ by an external consultant last month.

content.q: A new e-learning platform ___ next quarter.

content.q: Staff ___ about the new policy since January.

content.q: Each trainee ___ a mentor for the first six months.

content.q: New staff ___ (train) by experienced colleagues.

content.q: Our skills gap ___ (analyse) right now.

content.q: All employees ___ (must / give) a copy of the handbook.

content.q: The best trainees ___ (promote) next month.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · A new employee's first month
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Sara joined a retail company as a junior HR assistant. On her first day, she was welcomed by her manager and given a laptop, a staff card and an induction schedule. The onboarding programme lasted four weeks. During the first week, Sara was introduced to the team and taught the company's main policies.

A mentor was assigned to her, a senior HR officer who meets her every week. Sara is also trained on the job: she is shown how to update employee records and how to answer common questions. In addition, several e-learning modules will be completed by her before the end of the month.

After three months, Sara's training needs will be reviewed. If a skills gap is found, a workshop or a certification course may be offered. Her manager has already discussed a possible career path with her. If Sara performs well, she will be considered for promotion and for the company's high-potential programme.

content.q: Sara was given a laptop and a staff card on her first day.
content.why: Đoạn 1: cô được phát laptop, thẻ nhân viên và lịch định hướng.

content.q: The onboarding programme lasted one week.
content.why: Đoạn 1: chương trình onboarding kéo dài **bốn tuần**.

content.q: Sara's mentor is a senior HR officer.
content.why: Đoạn 2: mentor của cô là một HR officer cấp cao.

content.q: Sara learns only through e-learning modules.
content.why: Đoạn 2: cô vừa học **tại chỗ** vừa học qua e-learning.

content.q: What happened in Sara's first week?
content.why: Đoạn 1: tuần đầu cô được giới thiệu với nhóm và học các chính sách chính.
opts: She was introduced to the team and taught the main policies

content.q: How often does Sara meet her mentor?
content.why: Đoạn 2: 'who meets her every week'.

content.q: What may be offered if a skills gap is found?
content.why: Đoạn 3: có thể được đề nghị workshop hoặc khóa chứng chỉ.
opts: A workshop or a certification course

content.q: What may happen if Sara performs well?
content.why: Đoạn 3: cô sẽ được xem xét thăng chức.
opts: She will be considered for promotion

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Động từ khuyết thiếu chỉ sự bắt buộc
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct modal verb.
exercises.instruction_vi: Ngữ pháp: must, have to, don't have to, mustn't, should.

content.q: Employers ___ pay at least the minimum wage. It is the law.
content.why: Quy định pháp luật bắt buộc → **must**.

content.q: You ___ work overtime. It is voluntary.
content.why: Tự nguyện = không bắt buộc → **don't have to**.

content.q: Employees ___ share confidential information with competitors.
content.why: Bị cấm → **mustn't**.

content.q: You ___ read the contract carefully before you sign it.
content.why: Lời khuyên hợp lý → **should**.

content.q: In many countries, employers ___ give employees a written contract.
content.why: Quy định bắt buộc → **have to**.

content.q: Managers ___ discuss an employee's salary in public.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Điền từ đúng
exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence with a suitable modal verb.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Know your rights
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Before starting a new job, an employee signs an employment contract. It states the salary, working hours, annual leave and notice period. Employees should read it carefully, and employers have to give them a written copy. Under labour law, all workers must be paid at least the minimum wage, and overtime should be paid at a higher rate.

Companies also have policies that all staff must follow. The code of conduct explains how employees should behave, and the confidentiality agreement says they mustn't share secret information. Discrimination and harassment are strictly forbidden, and managers have to treat every employee equally. If an employee has a problem, he or she can file a grievance with HR, and the company must investigate it.

If an employee breaks the rules, the employer may take disciplinary action, but it can't dismiss someone without a fair reason. A worker who resigns does not have to explain why, but he or she should give the correct notice. Workers can also join a trade union, which negotiates a collective agreement on their behalf.

content.q: Employers have to give employees a written copy of the contract.
content.why: Đoạn 1: 'employers have to give them a written copy'.

content.q: Overtime should be paid at a lower rate.
content.why: Đoạn 1: làm thêm giờ nên được trả với mức **cao hơn**.

content.q: Employees mustn't share secret company information.
content.why: Đoạn 2: thỏa thuận bảo mật cấm chia sẻ thông tin mật.

content.q: A worker who resigns has to explain the reason.
content.why: Đoạn 3: người từ chức **không phải** giải thích lý do.

content.q: What does the code of conduct explain?
content.why: Đoạn 2: code of conduct giải thích cách nhân viên nên cư xử.

content.q: What can an employee do if he or she has a problem?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nhân viên có thể nộp khiếu nại cho HR.

content.q: When may an employer take disciplinary action?
content.why: Đoạn 3: nhân viên vi phạm quy định thì có thể bị xử lý kỷ luật.
opts: When an employee joins a union
When an employee breaks the rules
When an employee takes annual leave

content.q: What does a trade union negotiate?
content.why: Đoạn 3: công đoàn thương lượng thỏa ước lao động tập thể.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Why do good employees leave?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A software company noticed that its attrition rate was 25%, much higher than the industry average. HR ran exit interviews, and the results were clear. When employees had a heavy workload and no recognition, they started to look for another job. Several people also said they felt burnout because they could not leave work on time.

The HR manager made a plan. If the company improves its benefits package, more employees will stay. If managers hold regular performance appraisals, employees will know how they are doing. HR also asked for 360-degree feedback so that managers could understand their own weaknesses.

The company also introduced flexible hours and a small bonus for teams that reach their KPIs. If these changes work, morale and job satisfaction will improve, and absenteeism will fall. The CEO said she would invest even more in retention if the results were good after one year.

content.q: The company's attrition rate was 25%.
content.why: Đoạn 1: tỷ lệ hao hụt nhân sự là 25%.

content.q: HR learned the reasons for leaving from exit interviews.
content.why: Đoạn 1: HR thực hiện exit interview và kết quả rất rõ ràng.

content.q: No employee mentioned burnout.
content.why: Đoạn 1: **vài người** nói họ cảm thấy kiệt sức.

content.q: The company decided to remove its bonus system.
content.why: Đoạn 3: công ty **đưa ra** khoản thưởng nhỏ cho nhóm đạt KPI.

content.q: What did HR find in the exit interviews?
content.why: Đoạn 1: khối lượng việc nặng và thiếu ghi nhận khiến nhân viên tìm việc khác.
opts: A heavy workload and no recognition made people look for other jobs

content.q: Why did HR ask for 360-degree feedback?
content.why: Đoạn 2: để quản lý hiểu điểm yếu của chính mình.
opts: So managers could understand their own weaknesses

content.q: What did the company introduce?
content.why: Đoạn 3: giờ làm linh hoạt và thưởng nhỏ cho nhóm đạt KPI.
opts: Flexible hours and a small team bonus

content.q: What will happen if the changes work?
content.why: Đoạn 3: tinh thần và sự hài lòng sẽ cải thiện, nghỉ làm giảm.
opts: Morale and job satisfaction will improve

exercises.title: Bài 1 · How work has changed
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Ten years ago, most employees worked in an office from nine to five. Then technology changed everything. In 2020, millions of people started to work from home, and many companies discovered that remote work was possible. Since then, hybrid work has become common, and some employers have introduced a four-day week.

HR has also changed. Companies have adopted HR analytics and applicant tracking systems to make decisions with data. AI has helped recruiters to screen thousands of CVs, but experts have warned that an algorithm can repeat human bias, so data privacy and fairness are now important topics.

Employees' expectations have also changed. Many workers now ask about employee wellbeing, mental health and inclusion before they accept an offer. Employers that have failed to listen have lost talent, while employers of choice have grown stronger. As automation spreads, lifelong learning has become essential, because the skills that were useful five years ago are not always enough today.

content.q: In 2020, millions of people started to work from home.
content.why: Đoạn 1: năm 2020 hàng triệu người bắt đầu làm việc tại nhà.

content.q: Hybrid work has become less common since 2020.
content.why: Đoạn 1: hybrid work đã **trở nên phổ biến**.

content.q: AI has helped recruiters to screen thousands of CVs.
content.why: Đoạn 2: AI giúp nhà tuyển dụng sàng lọc hàng nghìn CV.

content.q: Experts say that an algorithm can never repeat human bias.
content.why: Đoạn 2: chuyên gia cảnh báo thuật toán **có thể lặp lại** thiên kiến.

content.q: What have some employers introduced?
content.why: Đoạn 1: một số nhà tuyển dụng đã áp dụng tuần làm việc bốn ngày.

content.q: Why are data privacy and fairness important topics?
content.why: Đoạn 2: thuật toán có thể lặp lại thiên kiến của con người.
opts: An algorithm can repeat human bias

content.q: What do many workers ask about before accepting an offer?
content.why: Đoạn 3: họ hỏi về wellbeing, sức khỏe tinh thần và hòa nhập.

content.q: Why has lifelong learning become essential?
content.why: Đoạn 3: tự động hóa lan rộng và kỹ năng cũ có thể không còn đủ.
opts: Automation spreads and old skills may not be enough
